info.title: Tangle Sandbox API
info.description: Create sandboxes, run commands and agents in them, and manage your account over HTTP. Send an account API key as a bearer token.

E2BApiKey.name: X-API-Key
E2BApiKey.description: Your Tangle API key, sent the way the E2B SDK sends its key.

SessionCookie.name: session
SessionCookie.description: Browser session set by a completed sign-in. The same value also works as a Bearer token.

MfaChallengeCookie.name: mfa_challenge
MfaChallengeCookie.description: Set by a sign-in that still needs a second factor. It authorizes only `POST /auth/mfa/challenge`.

BearerAuth.description: Use an account API key from a trusted server, CI job, or CLI. Do not put account keys in browser JavaScript. See the authentication guide for scoped browser tokens.

status.description: degraded when the oldest due work is overdue, or any row is auth-refused, keyless on a paid plan or repeatedly deferred.

readAgeSeconds.description: Seconds since the queue was last read.

oldestAgeSeconds.description: Age of the oldest row; 0 when the queue is empty.

overdueAgeSeconds.description: Seconds the oldest due row has waited.

authRefusedDepth.description: Rows the ledger has refused for an authorization reason for about an hour.

serviceRefusedDepth.description: The subset of authRefusedDepth refused on the service credential rather than a payer key.

authRefusedKeys.description: Distinct payer credentials among the rows refused on a payer credential.

keylessPaidDepth.description: Pro and Enterprise compute rows without a payer key; Free rows are excluded.

budgetRefusedDepth.description: Rows waiting on a spent key budget until their attempts run out, then set aside.

deferredDepth.description: Rows the ledger has deferred repeatedly.

keyRevokedDepth.description: Rows refused because the payer's key was revoked; set aside at the first refusal.

budgetClosedDepth.description: Rows refused on a key budget that can never be raised; set aside at the first refusal.

error.description: `unauthorized`, `invalid_delegated_key`, `invalid_fleet_token` or `invalid_platform_key` on a 401; key verification also answers `email_verification_required` or `platform_unavailable`.

metadataPrefix.description: Metadata key to required value prefix. A sandbox matches when every named key holds a string value that starts with its prefix.

accountIncludedBytes.description: Egress included with the account each month, shared by its sandboxes: 2 TB on paid plans, 100 GiB on Free.

accountOverageBytes.description: The account's bytes beyond its allowance; 0 on Free.

includedBytes.description: Egress included with the account each month, shared by its sandboxes: 2 TB on paid plans, 100 GiB on Free.

overageBytes.description: The account's bytes beyond its allowance; 0 on Free.

accountCapBytes.description: Egress included with the account each month, shared by its sandboxes: 2 TB on paid plans, 100 GiB on Free.

rejectedEnvKeys.description: With code RESUME_ENV_KEY_NOT_ACCEPTED: the supplied env keys this sandbox does not take on resume.

missingEnvKeys.description: With code RESUME_ENV_REQUIRED: the env keys to pass on the next resume.

reason.description: With code RESUME_RESTORE_REFUSED: why the workspace could not be restored, such as workspace_restore_missing or workspace_restore_quota_exceeded.

retryable.description: With code RESUME_RESTORE_REFUSED: whether another resume can succeed without operator action. The sandbox stays stopped and keeps its snapshot either way.

source.description: Repository serving this listing. primary-fallback means customer listing failed and primary history may be incomplete.

final.description: The snapshot the sandbox's last stop captured, listed for a deleted sandbox.

deleted.description: The sandbox is deleted: the listing holds only its retained final snapshot, which a create with fromSnapshot and fromSandboxId restores.

accountBytes.description: The account's egress this month, the figure the allowance is enforced against.

includedBytes.description: Egress included with the account each month, shared by its sandboxes: 2 TB on paid plans, 100 GiB on Free.

overage.description: Beyond the allowance: billed at `usdPerGb` on paid plans; refused on Free, which is never charged.

usdPerGb.description: Price per decimal GB beyond the account's included egress on this plan.

overageBytes.description: The account's bytes beyond its allowance; 0 on Free.

projectedChargeUsd.description: Sum of the sandboxes' `chargeUsd`: what the meter has charged or reserved for this month so far.

unattributedBytes.description: Account egress recorded before per-sandbox month records existed, so it has no sandbox row.

accountCapBytes.description: Egress included with the account each month, shared by its sandboxes: 2 TB on paid plans, 100 GiB on Free.

sandboxIncludedBytes.description: Egress included with the account each month, shared by its sandboxes: 2 TB on paid plans, 100 GiB on Free.

chargeUsd.description: USD of the egress charges the meter created for this sandbox and month, debited or awaiting replay.

includedBytes.description: Egress included with the account each month, shared by its sandboxes: 2 TB on paid plans, 100 GiB on Free.

address.description: E.164 number, mailbox, or `@handle` on a shared router

connect.description: Text to send to `routerAddress` to reach this line

runAsKeyId.description: Execution key ID; pass it back when reauthorizing

sandboxId.description: Empty for member instances and shared applications

keyPrefix.description: Each member's instance key is this prefix plus 32 hex digits

metadata.description: Up to 16 fields; keys up to 64 characters

context.description: `shared` turns see other shared members' recent exchanges

tools.description: `chat` sessions get no shell, files, subagents or MCP servers

roles.description: Keyed by role name: a lowercase word of up to 32 characters

kind.description: `none` answers asks, coded replies and notices only, and runs no agent

backend.description: Agent backend configuration for member sessions

roles.description: Role name to its agent scope

backend.description: Agent backend configuration for member sessions

members.description: Member address to its own backend; up to 50

context.description: Up to 8 fixed fields sent with every candidate

updatedAt.description: Member revision, as sent to an application callback

delivery.description: Provider delivery facts; null when unproven

generation.description: Counts the key's sandboxes; each replacement adds one.

sandboxId.description: The sandbox serving the key now, or null.

profileVersion.description: The agent profile version that new sessions bind to.

unstartableSince.description: Epoch milliseconds of the current sandbox's first failed start, or null.

delete.description: Takes the `session` cookie, or its token as a Bearer token, from a browser sign-in; an API key, CLI token or runtime token gets 403 `SESSION_AUTH_REQUIRED`. It also needs the `recent_auth` cookie that sign-in sets, which expires soon after. Marks the account deleted, revokes the API keys Sandbox created for it, except a team's keys, and clears the `session` cookie.

401.description: No valid credential, or no `recent_auth` cookie from a recent sign-in

403.description: Key verification refused the credential, or an API key, CLI token or runtime token called a route that needs a browser sign-in (`SESSION_AUTH_REQUIRED`)

500.description: The account could not be deleted

502.description: Key verification returned an incomplete identity

503.description: Key verification is unavailable; retry after the `Retry-After` seconds

import os
import sys
from urllib.error import HTTPError
from urllib.parse import quote, urlencode
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

api_key = os.environ.get("TANGLE_API_KEY")
if not api_key: raise SystemExit("Set TANGLE_API_KEY in a trusted runtime")
base_url = os.environ.get("SANDBOX_BASE_URL", "https://sandbox.tangle.tools").rstrip("/")
url = f"{base_url}/auth/account"
headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}", "Accept": "*/*"}
request = Request(url, data=None, headers=headers, method="DELETE")
try:
    with urlopen(request, timeout=float(os.environ.get("SANDBOX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", "300"))) as response:
        while chunk := response.read(8192):
            sys.stdout.buffer.write(chunk)
except HTTPError as error:
    detail = error.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    raise SystemExit(f"HTTP {error.code}: {detail}") from error

  --url "$url" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer ${TANGLE_API_KEY:?Set TANGLE_API_KEY}" \
  --header "Accept: */*"

get.description: Takes the one-time `code` from Tangle sign-in and the `oauth_state` cookie set when sign-in started. Always answers with a redirect. On success it sets the `session` and `recent_auth` cookies and redirects to the `redirect_to` target from sign-in, by default `/dashboard`. When the account has two-factor sign-in on, it sets the `mfa_challenge` cookie and redirects to the dashboard `/mfa` page instead. A CLI sign-in redirects to its loopback `callback_url` with `grant_token`, `expires_at` and `session_expires_at`; exchange the `grant_token` at `POST /auth/cli/exchange`. On failure it redirects to `/login?error=<reason>` on the dashboard, or to the loopback `callback_url` with `error=<reason>`. Reasons include `missing_code`, `csrf_mismatch`, `auth_failed`, `email_verification_required` and `paid_access_required`.

import os
import sys
from urllib.error import HTTPError
from urllib.parse import quote, urlencode
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

api_key = os.environ.get("TANGLE_API_KEY")
if not api_key: raise SystemExit("Set TANGLE_API_KEY in a trusted runtime")
base_url = os.environ.get("SANDBOX_BASE_URL", "https://sandbox.tangle.tools").rstrip("/")
url = f"{base_url}/auth/callback"
query = {}
_code = os.environ.get("SANDBOX_CODE")
if _code is not None: query["code"] = _code
_state = os.environ.get("SANDBOX_STATE")
if _state is not None: query["state"] = _state
_error = os.environ.get("SANDBOX_ERROR")
if _error is not None: query["error"] = _error
_error_description = os.environ.get("SANDBOX_ERROR_DESCRIPTION")
if _error_description is not None: query["error_description"] = _error_description

headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}", "Accept": "*/*"}
request = Request(url, data=None, headers=headers, method="GET")
try:
    with urlopen(request, timeout=float(os.environ.get("SANDBOX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", "300"))) as response:
        while chunk := response.read(8192):
            sys.stdout.buffer.write(chunk)
except HTTPError as error:
    detail = error.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    raise SystemExit(f"HTTP {error.code}: {detail}") from error

from urllib.parse import quote, urlencode

api_key = os.environ.get("TANGLE_API_KEY")

post.summary: Stream a command dispatch to fleet machines
post.description: Takes the same body as POST /v1/fleets/{fleetId}/dispatch and answers as server-sent events while the machines run. Each machine emits fleet.dispatch.branch.started and fleet.dispatch.branch.finished. The stream ends with fleet.dispatch.finished or fleet.dispatch.error. A failure before the stream starts is a JSON error instead. A dropped connection cancels the machines that have not started.

200.description: Server-sent events (text/event-stream). Each frame has an event name and a JSON data field, modeled by the schema.

400.description: Invalid fleet ID or dispatch body (VALIDATION_ERROR)

402.description: The account that pays for the fleet has recorded debt (INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE)

403.description: The fleet token is not scoped to this fleet or lacks the exec or prompt action, or the backend's profile secret isolation is unavailable (FORBIDDEN, PROFILE_SECRET_ISOLATION_UNAVAILABLE)

409.description: A dispatch with this dispatchId is already active (CONFLICT)

429.description: The paying account's balance is below the admission floor (QUOTA_EXCEEDED)

503.description: A selected machine could not be asked to prove secret isolation; retry after Retry-After (PROFILE_SECRET_ISOLATION_UNAVAILABLE)

import os
import sys
from urllib.error import HTTPError
from urllib.parse import quote, urlencode
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

api_key = os.environ.get("TANGLE_API_KEY")
if not api_key: raise SystemExit("Set TANGLE_API_KEY in a trusted runtime")
base_url = os.environ.get("SANDBOX_BASE_URL", "https://sandbox.tangle.tools").rstrip("/")
_lineId = os.environ.get("SANDBOX_LINE_ID")
if not _lineId: raise SystemExit("Set SANDBOX_LINE_ID")
url = f"{base_url}/v1/lines/{quote(_lineId or '', safe='')}/remind"
headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}", "Accept": "*/*"}
# Save a request body matching the schema above as request.json.
with open(os.environ.get("SANDBOX_REQUEST_FILE", "request.json"), "rb") as request_file:
    body = request_file.read()
headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
request = Request(url, data=body, headers=headers, method="POST")
try:
    with urlopen(request, timeout=float(os.environ.get("SANDBOX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", "300"))) as response:
        while chunk := response.read(8192):
            sys.stdout.buffer.write(chunk)
except HTTPError as error:
    detail = error.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    raise SystemExit(f"HTTP {error.code}: {detail}") from error

schema.description: Canonical create request. Additional API validation: isolated owner context requires a fresh personal workspace without teams, templates, snapshots, stored scripts, enabled SSH, SSH keys, stored secrets, git read grants or profile owner connections. Native auth secret references cannot be overridden by inline env and must be supported by the selected backend. Native auth and API key environment references must be selected in secrets (or secrets=all). fromSnapshot requires fromSandboxId. agent=false forbids backend, bare=true and stored scripts, and requires Docker. Egress domains must use well-formed domain patterns, and strict policies must satisfy the supported implicit-host restrictions. Bounded JSON predicates and AgentProfile refinements remain enforced.
x-tangle-runtime-validation: Custom bounded JSON predicates and AgentProfile refinements remain enforced by the create request validator.

delete.description: Deletes the sandbox. A sandbox with live branch children is refused (409 CHILDREN_EXIST) unless `cascade=true`, which deletes the whole lineage children-first. Platform-managed snapshot repositories are reclaimed after the deleted-retention window for internal accounts only; customer repositories remain until explicitly deleted by their owner. Preservation holds and active exports/restores are honored. With `wait=false` it may instead answer 202 as soon as the delete is durably accepted: poll `operation.statusUrl` (or `Location`) until the operation is `succeeded` (with `result.deleted`) or `failed`. The runtime runs and bills until the delete kills it. An `Idempotency-Key` names the delete for a retry whose 202 was lost. With `until=removed`, that status URL keeps polling through physical reclaim. Cascades keep the synchronous answer; a 200 means the delete finished.

202.description: Delete accepted (`wait=false`); it finishes in the background. Or create retirement is pending

403.description: Driver not allowed

409.description: Sandbox has live branch children, lacks a confirmed final snapshot, could not prove absence, is under an operator retention hold, or its Idempotency-Key names a different delete

503.description: Sandbox billing state is temporarily unavailable

get.description: Every destination this sandbox's egress proxy allowed or refused in the inspected window, and whether that observation can be trusted. This is the OPPOSITE question to /egress/denials, and unlike that route it is deliberately not best-effort: it exists to support the negative claim 'this sandbox reached nothing', which an empty list cannot carry on its own. `destinations: []` with `complete: true` is evidence; `destinations: []` with `complete: false` is an absence of evidence, and `incompleteReasons` names what was missing. A hop that could not reach the host reports `hop-unreachable` rather than an empty list, so an unreadable path can never be read as a clean sandbox.

Returns a paste-able MCP host config (Claude Desktop, Cursor, claude-code, codex, …) plus a freshly-minted, capability-scoped JWT. The token is short-lived and can ONLY call MCP routes; it cannot reach admin endpoints (/exec, /files, …) on the sandbox. Call again to rotate.

post.description: Speculative rollouts: branches the RUNNING sandbox into `n` copy-on-write children, sends the same message `parts` to a fresh agent session in every child in parallel, and (optionally) scores each child by running `scorer.command` inside it; exit 0 passes and stdout is parsed as the numeric score. post.description: Session/project tokens read SessionGateway streams. Runtime tokens grant `session-runtime`: read + workspace + terminal, or `read-only`: sandbox-wide read. post.summary: Restore a sandbox from a snapshot
post.description: Restores the whole workspace from the snapshot. The optional JSON body `{ "paths": ["relative/path"] }` restores only those workspace-relative paths and leaves every other file untouched; an empty body restores the whole workspace. A repeat under the same `Idempotency-Key` answers the same job for an hour after it ends; the same key with another snapshot or paths is another restore.

With `wait=false` it may instead answer 202 as soon as the stop is durably accepted: poll `operation.statusUrl` (or `Location`) until the operation is `succeeded` or `failed`. from urllib.parse import quote, urlencode
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

api_key = os.environ.get("TANGLE_API_KEY")
if not api_key: raise SystemExit("Set TANGLE_API_KEY in a trusted runtime")
base_url = os.environ.get("SANDBOX_BASE_URL", "https://sandbox.tangle.tools").rstrip("/")
url = f"{base_url}/v1/usage"
headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}", "Accept": "*/*"}
request = Request(url, data=None, headers=headers, method="GET")
try:
    with urlopen(request, timeout=float(os.environ.get("SANDBOX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", "300"))) as response:
        while chunk := response.read(8192):
            sys.stdout.buffer.write(chunk)
except HTTPError as error:
    detail = error.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    raise SystemExit(f"HTTP {error.code}: {detail}") from error

get.description: The account's egress for one calendar month (UTC) as the meter recorded it: the account total, the plan's allowance, the overage beyond it, each sandbox's bytes, and what the meter has charged or reserved. Paid plans include 2 TB per account per month, shared by its sandboxes, then bill per decimal GB; Free accounts are capped at 100 GiB per month and never charged.

schema.description: Calendar month, `YYYY-MM` in UTC. Defaults to the current month.

parameters.description: Calendar month, `YYYY-MM` in UTC. Defaults to the current month.
parameters.name: month
